result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback position: it covers affiliates without even requiring notice and permits transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction. It also adopts the preferred contractor coverage. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing use restrictions and other commercial terms. However, it does not fully reach the preferred position because it adds no perpetual/irrevocable protection for paid-up licences or uncured-material-breach termination standard for subscription licences. The drafting is generally professional, although the margin comment overstates that the full playbook position was achieved.
